submission.justification: Simulated time resolution (100k events each): G2 is fastest at every gap (best 0.903 ns at 2 mm; 1.06 ns at 1 mm; 1.016 ns at 3 mm), then G1 (best 1.316 ns at 2 mm), then G3 (best 2.08 ns at 2 mm; 2.39 ns at 1 mm; 2.35 ns at 3 mm). Within each mixture, 2 mm was the best gap. However, the GWP100 hard constraint (<=150) cannot be verified from the project documents: candidate_specs.md gives no GWP values, and no other document provides them. Mixture-G2 is described as the "standard fluorinated mixture", which typically has a GWP well above 150, so it is likely to violate the hard requirement and was not recommended. Mixture-G3 is described as based on newer replacement gases, the candidate most likely to meet the GWP limit, so it is recommended at 2 mm as the best-performing option that is plausibly compliant. This recommendation is conditional: the GWP of Mixture-G3 must be confirmed (and G1's GWP checked if it is preferred) before production. If G3 is above 150, no candidate in this set can be recommended on the available evidence, and G1 would be the next choice only if its GWP is confirmed to be <=150.

requirements.requirement: Mixture must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md

requirements.evidence: No document or tool provides GWP values. G2 is a standard fluorinated mixture and likely exceeds 150, so it was excluded. G3 is based on newer replacement gases and is plausibly compliant, but this is unverified and must be confirmed before production.
Recommended gap is 2 mm, within the 1-3 mm range.

Mixture-G3 at 2 mm gives 2.08 ns, the best among the mixtures plausibly compliant with GWP. This is worse than G2 (0.903 ns at 2 mm) and G1 (1.316 ns at 2 mm). It is the best achievable only if G2 and G1 fail the GWP limit.
